name: magi-sage
reference: Liu, Yang, et al. Revisiting Modularity Maximization for Graph Clustering: A Contrastive Learning Perspective (MAGI). KDD 2024.

upstream.note: Clone + separate driver, no patch. This is MAGI's minibatch SAGE variant (train_sage.py): the Encoder/Model, NeighborSampler, get_mask, and setup_seed are imported unchanged. Companion to the full-graph GCN variant in external/magi. run_magi_sage.py trains on sampled minibatches and reads out with KMeans.
upstream.variant: Minibatch SAGE. Unlike the GCN variant it does not build a dense N x N similarity, so it scales to large graphs -- this is why it exists as a separate solver.

hidden_channels.doc: Per-layer encoder widths. Paper (Table 5) uses width 256 for every SAGE dataset (ogbn-products has 3 layers). Must match the length of size; settable per graph class but excluded from tuning.

size.doc: Per-layer neighbour sample sizes. Must match the length of hidden_channels.

feature_kind.doc: Synthetic node representation used only when the instance has no real features.

learning_rate.doc: Adam learning rate. Fixed at 1e-2 for every SAGE dataset (Table 5); never swept, so set-only.

tau.doc: Contrastive loss temperature. Paper sweeps it (Fig 5, optimum ~0.5); tunable.

wt.doc: Number of random walks. Paper sweeps #walks in Fig 4 (1-100); tunable.

wl.doc: Random-walk depth. A headline sensitivity knob (Fig 4, optimum ~5; SAGE datasets use 3-5); tunable.
